morgan_sales: Hey product team — sales intake from KiteLabs. They want a committed Dedicated pool + predictable night-time burst window for their consumer chat feature. Asking for guidance on pool shape and autoscaling policy.

alex_pm: Thanks Morgan. Do we have their expected QPS/peak tokens? Any throughput profile?

morgan_sales: They gave rough numbers: 250 RPS sustained daytime, peaks to ~2k RPS for 30m windows, average response length ~40 tokens. Embeddings load is separate, small.

sam_infra: Quick calc: for 40-token responses at 2k RPS peak that's 80k tokens/sec peak. With current Llama2-Chat x-token throughput on p4d-ish, rough GPU concurrency = ~8-10 per GPU under continuous batching. Need to confirm model family and quantization.

jessica_eng: Also need to know latency SLO. If they require <200ms p50, we can't batch too aggressively. What SLAs did KiteLabs ask for?

morgan_sales: They said "interactive" target, prefer p50 <250ms, p95 <800ms. Willing to pay for reserved capacity.

alex_pm: Ok. Product asks: (1) recommended committed GPU count for base daytime steady state, (2) burst policy shape (how many extra GPUs during 30m peaks and how to trigger), (3) autoscaling cooldowns and fallback model variants to reduce cost during spikes.

sam_infra: Proposal draft: base pool = 12 GPUs (optimized for low-latency inference on the chosen model/quant). Have a burst band of +8 GPUs auto-attach for up to 45 minutes when aggregated queue depth exceeds threshold X. Use quick scale-up path using warm standby images and KV cache priming.

jessica_eng: Variant strategy: offer two model variants — high-accuracy quantized FP16 serving for steady state, and a latency-optimized 4-bit quantized variant that drops p95 but reduces GPU tokens/sec cost ~1.8x. Configure automatic fallback when queue latency > 300ms or error rate rises. Document quality/regression expectations.

morgan_sales: Sounds good. Sales asks if we can guarantee the night burst for launch week (first month) and then move to dynamic billing thereafter. Is that feasible?

alex_pm: We can offer a temporary guaranteed burst reservation for 30 days with a higher committed charge. Need sign-off from finance and infra capacity planning. Also need operational runbook and rollback plan.

sam_infra: Operational notes: warm-standby nodes must have KV cache primed to avoid cold-start thundering. We'll keep a small pool of pre-initialized partitions sized for the burst increment. Also add a soft-fallback route to hosted smaller model in case Dedicated pool hits capacity limits.

jessica_eng: Launch criteria checklist: 
- Load test simulating 2k RPS 40-token responses with canary traffic to verify latency/SLOs
- Model variant QA with 100 sample prompts from KiteLabs to validate drift/regressions
- Autoscaler stress test (scale up/scale down cycles) and cooldown verification
- Cost/runbook sign-off from finance + security review for private data handling

morgan_sales: I'll loop in KiteLabs to confirm test data and the billing term. They also want the burst window to be predictable nightly 01:00-02:00 UTC — can we do scheduled bursts instead of reactive?

sam_infra: Yes, scheduled bursts are easier: reserve pool attach at 00:55, detach at 02:05 with health checks. Combine scheduled + reactive: scheduled ensures capacity, reactive handles unexpected spikes.

alex_pm: Prioritization: this request rates as P2 for product backlog (customer-critical but standard ask). Proposed sprint scope:
- Week 1: spike + capacity calc, ops runbook, estimate cost
- Week 2: infra changes for scheduled attach/detach, autoscaler tuning knobs
- Week 3: QA + canary with sales-managed customer traffic

jessica_eng: Risks: model fallbacks may change output distribution; we need regression alerting (Eval sets) and rollback. Also ensure billing events for scheduled burst are visible to KiteLabs in console.

morgan_sales: Thanks. Can someone draft a short SOW + acceptance criteria for the customer to sign? Also need timeline we can share.

alex_pm: I'll draft SOW and acceptance criteria doc and post in this thread tomorrow. Action items:
- sam_infra: compute final GPU count + ops plan (due in 48h)
- jessica_eng: define model variant tuning and regression tests (due in 72h)
- morgan_sales: confirm KiteLabs requested burst window and billing preference (due EOD)

oncall-bot: Reminder: pinging infra oncall for capacity reservations may take 24-48h to provision.

morgan_sales: Noted. Thanks all. Will wait for drafts. :thumbsup:
